title: nsF5 Steganography: syndrome matrix coding, wet-paper coding, blind steganalysis, and a bilingual teaching toolkit
description:
An open-source teaching and research toolkit for image steganography and steganalysis. It implements the nsF5 algorithm (binary Hamming syndrome matrix coding with wet-paper coding), SHA-256 content keying, blind steganalysis (chi-square and RS analysis), and supervised detection with LightGBM, together with a bilingual handbook, ten runnable notebooks, an interactive browser laboratory, and a desktop GUI.

Every reported number is labelled with its corpus, protocol, and traceability in docs/RESULTS.md; the repository also documents the errors found during its own audits (source-photo leakage and an SRM feature-scaling defect) rather than quietly replacing the numbers. See the "更正记录" section of the README.
notes: Includes the bilingual handbook (Chinese/English), ten teaching notebooks, an interactive browser laboratory, and the experiments that produce docs/RESULTS.md.
